The sea kept taking things, but the keepers kept giving them back: stories, warnings, maps, and the quiet promise that no stranger to this shore would ever be entirely alone.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的梦里。湿砖映着路灯，像一层薄而脆的蜜。高楼的窗大多黑着，只有便利店亮着暖黄灯光，门轻轻开合，漏出咖啡机低低的嗡鸣。送报车驶过街角，尾灯在空巷拖出两道红线。一只白猫穿过斑马线，嗅着潮湿的栀子。风从江面吹来，带着野草与将醒未醒的气息。天还没亮，城市已在呼吸，像一个翻身将醒的人。","w03":"- Recursion is when a job says, “To solve this, first do a smaller version of the same job.”\n- You keep making the job smaller until you reach a simple stopping case that you can answer right away.\n- Then you pass each answer back up, one step at a time, until the original job is finished."}
